content.short: Grass is a Solana based DePIN that pays users for sharing unused bandwidth so AI labs can collect public web data at scale.
content.description: Grass is a decentralized physical infrastructure network built as a data rollup on Solana. Participants install a browser extension or mobile app that turns idle residential bandwidth into a node, and AI labs route public web collection through that distributed pool, avoiding the handful of datacenter ranges that sites routinely block. Validators check the returned data and a zero knowledge processor proves it was not tampered with in transit, so buyers get provenance. Contributors earn GRASS for the bandwidth they supply.
